findings.summary: The discount is applied before the tax is added. Totals come out too low.
findings.failure_scenario: A cart of 100 with a 10% discount and 20% tax totals 108 instead of 110.

findings.summary: A cart with a `None` price may raise in `total()`. The caller never passes one today.
findings.failure_scenario: An import that leaves a price empty makes the checkout page fail.

findings.summary: The retry loop sleeps 5 s | no backoff.
findings.failure_scenario: Under load every client retries at the same moment.
